title: Flamegraph tree transforms must carry valueRight (diff side) on every LevelItem they create
answers: diff flame graph tooltip shows NaN% or NaNundefined
sandwich view in diff flamegraph shows undefined baseline/comparison
why is valueRight undefined on merged nodes
adding a new tree transform to grafana-flamegraph
body:
Symptom: In a Diff flame graph, switching to Sandwich view (Callers/Callees) and hovering a node shows `NaN%`, `NaNundefined` or `undefined` for Baseline/Comparison/Diff.
Root cause: packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.ts:mergeSubtrees and getParentSubtrees built new LevelItems recomputing only `.value`, so `valueRight` was undefined; FlameGraphTooltip.tsx:getDiffTooltipData used `item.valueRight!` in arithmetic and unit formatting.
Fix pattern: whenever a transform builds or rebases a LevelItem, handle `valueRight` alongside `value`: sum it when merging (only if some input has `valueRight !== undefined`, else leave undefined so non-diff profiles stay non-diff), copy it when rebasing a node onto its child's value. Consumers should default a missing `valueRight` to 0 (`item.valueRight ?? 0`) rather than non-null assert.
Constraints: `valueRight` presence is how diff mode is detected per item, so don't set it to 0 for non-diff profiles. `getDiffTooltipData` still asserts `levels[0][0].valueRight!` for the root total; that relies on the root of diff data always having it.
applies: packages/grafana-flamegraph tree transforms (sandwich/merge) and diff tooltip code
